title: tac.summary
description: One compact paragraph of a side's picture: hostile, unknown and friendly counts, hostile missiles, missiles inbound to own units, the shortest time to closest approach, optionally ranged from a reference unit. Needs the BDArmory binding in a flight scene (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE tactical_not_attached without it).

view.description: Picture to read: a team name (your own side unless you are a human, referee or director), or "god" for the truth (needs privilege or fog off). Defaults to the session's side.

ref.description: reference unit for ranges: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id or an exact unit name.

units.description: distance units for text: nm (naval: nm, kt, ft) or km (metric)
